coverage.policy: Three new complete preexisting Rust reads beyond XX; searches, rereads and test files do not inflate coverage.

findings.title: Ganancias de partición mezclan estadísticas del padre completo e hijo submuestreado
findings.mechanism: Padre sobre idx completo, hijo izquierdo sobre probe y derecho por resta entre poblaciones diferentes; conteos de min_child sobre probe.

reproductions.case: 4096 balanced rows, h=1, g=+1/-1, lambda=1; probe every other row
Full child 80 rows, probe child 20, min_child 40

repairs: Probe only proposes thresholds; all sufficient statistics and child counts use full bootstrap multiset.
Ordered sweep with prefix/suffix sums preserves duplicates and rejects invalid statistics.
limits: Approximate threshold proposals, regularization and fixed gain cutoff remain.
O(n log n + q log q) per feature/node; no real training latency measured.

findings.title: Selección y promoción compartían evidencia y no se purgaban ventanas de etiquetas
findings.mechanism: Chronological row split discards label end times; early stopping and final gate use same validation observations. Separate filename does not ensure disjoint time.
repairs: TrainingSamples retains aligned features/labels/closed information intervals.
Purge each training interval with end >= first selection start, including nonmonotone ends.
Require --test-in for --promote before I/O; final test starts after max label end of all used train/selection evidence.
Freeze model before final test; baseline estimated on train only.
Name regression score baseline-relative skill, reject invalid evidence and remove absolute 1e-12 baseline cutoff.
limits: Per-invocation separation only; no holdout-reuse ledger, multiple-testing correction or experiment manifest.
Conservative full horizon even if label resolves earlier may overpurge.
Within-set dependence, source availability, costs and calibration remain unvalidated.

findings.title: max-samples no imponía máximo y podía densificar el muestreo
findings.mechanism: Inverted stride condition and absent counter; zero budget divides by zero and stride*budget may overflow.
repairs: Explicit reservation counter, positive-domain checks and checked timestamp addition.
Budget applies per-file eligible attempts, including later rejected labels.
limits: Not a global budget across all train/validation/test files.
Does not bound every tick read, full process memory or wall time.
Minimum labels and fixed cadence/warmup policies remain.

findings.title: Probabilidades de primer paso, éxito del corto y PnL no equivalentes
findings.mechanism: Discarding timeout labels conditions on resolution; 1-p of long first-hit success is not short TP success with different barriers or net profitability.
repairs: Corrected misleading comments, including unsupported equivalence to break-even.
limits: No functional label migration, timeout mass model, cost-aware action target or operational change.

findings.title: Exportador CSV conserva reloj y etiquetas incompatibles y contexto constante
findings.mechanism: target_5m uses 500 ticks. Short SL check dominates long TP and long SL dominates short TP. Terminal fallback defines another target. 54D proxies/constants differ from forest 48D schema.

reproductions.case: mid 100 -> 100.20 labels positive before required long TP 100.36

findings.impact: Invalid 1:1 alignment claim and non-comparable targets/context along the located CSV->DarkAlpha route.
closure: Versioned schema with event/availability time, instrument, units and label intervals.
Shared action-aware label definition and explicit censoring.
Transactional export, checked flush, invalid-row ledger.
limits: Auxiliary binary unchanged and not executed; operational activation not established.
No claim CSV feeds train_forest or all consumers.

findings.title: Validador OHLC usa proxy no observado y resolución intrabar optimista
findings.mechanism: Pseudo OBI equals 2p-1 for positive volume, where p is bar close location. Entry bar exits skipped; later ambiguous bars test TP before SL. No costs/gaps/terminal; WR>55% and positive sum claimed as independent statistical edge.

reproductions.case: Long entry 100, later high 101 / low 99, barriers +/-0.2%: both hit but code credits TP; OHLC does not identify order.

closure: Name observable correctly, preserve ambiguity or use actual paths.
Model entry/terminal, costs and evaluation independence; report statistical uncertainty.
limits: POC route only; no operational gate or current result verified.

findings.title: CSV neuronal sin contrato estricto de dimensión y target
findings.mechanism: Rows admit 25..54 features; loops use first-row dimension. NaN target maps to zero, positive infinity to one; malformed features become zero without quality mask.

reproductions.case: First row 54D and second 25D both accepted; mean loop indexes second row out of bounds at index 25.

closure: Strict schema and finite typed targets.
Reject/quarantine with reason counts; recorded imputation policy fitted only on train.
limits: Not executed on malformed dataset; auxiliary source unchanged.

findings.title: Publicación neuronal tras ajuste sin test independiente
findings.mechanism: Scaler and model fit entire CSV; training BCE only; direct model-path write without candidate/promote distinction or independent gate.
findings.methodology_note: Fitting scaler on all intended training data is not itself test leakage: there is no test. Absence of independent evidence and publication control is the confirmed defect.
closure: Purged temporal train/selection/test with schema and provenance.
Evaluate exact serialized model, candidate path, manifest and explicit transactional promotion.
limits: Writing target confirmed; current live activation not proven.
Protection added to train_forest does not protect this route.

findings.title: Targets vol y volu ponderados por evento no por reloj físico
findings.mechanism: RMS returns includes event-count denominator and no duration normalization; quantity average is event-weighted depth, not executed volume or time-weighted depth.

reproductions.case: One nonzero return r and n-1 zeros: adding n unchanged-price events divides RMS by sqrt(2).
Depth 10 for 9s and 100 for 1s: time-weighted mean 19, one-event-per-state mean 55.

repairs: Descriptions now state actual units and estimator; corrected 500*75ms arithmetic.
closure: Choose economic target and unit explicitly; test event-duplication/time-refinement/unit/instrument transformations.
Version labels/models/consumers for any semantic migration.
limits: Target formulas unchanged; no newly claimed clock volatility estimator or multi-asset comparability.

theory.title: Contratos de medida, intervalos informacionales y evidencia para evolución continua
requirements: Declare observation process, unit, timestamp/availability, support and uncertainty per node.
Keep mathematical horizon domain separate from observed resolution and update cadence.
Stable, traceable judge from gene expression to attributed net outcome and independent promotion.
No prestige-based physical/quantum integration; require identified observables, numerical error, baseline, ablation and cost.

non_evidence: First inference invocation used a name filter and ran zero tests; corrected to --test.
Initial mechanical extraction syntax error fixed before historical red assertions; not a historical bug.
Manual ignored model inventory was not run again.
Repeated green runs not counted twice.
